{{Vanilla|Cooked Salmon}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Cooked large fish''' is a [[food]] item made by cooking any large fish. It heals {{Value|Cooked Large Fish|heals}}. It replaces {{MCW|Cooked Salmon|cooked salmon}}.

== Obtaining ==
=== Cooking ===
Every salmon-based fish cooks into cooked large fish, since the recipe matches any <code>minecraft:salmon</code>. That includes [[salmon]] and 24 custom fish (see [[Fish]]). Cooking takes {{Value|Cooked Large Fish|cook_time}} in an [[Oven]] or on [[Kindling]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/cooked_salmon.json}}</ref>
{{Recipes}}

== Usage ==
=== Food ===
Eating it gives a hidden Regeneration III for 60 ticks (3 seconds), which heals {{Value|Cooked Large Fish|heals}}.
